in_arabic.name: Nibal
in_arabic.long_meaning: Nibal هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root n-b-l, meaning 'to be firm, steadfast, strong'. In Islamic history, Nibal refers to a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his unwavering faith.
